_help: Each turn: text, at (minutes since the first message), optional s (session key, default main) and c (customer id). expect keys, all optional: kind (query, clarify, social, handoff), language (en hi ml ta te kn), intents (list, all must be present), query_has and query_lacks (lists of text), status (active, restored, new), notice (restored, expired_new, or empty), notice_has (text), reason, resolved_from, switched, mixed, escalated, last_order, name, turns_min.
